exposure: K-technique for laparoscopic apical suspension using barbed sutures
outcome: efficacy of barbed sutures in prolapse repair
cohort: Eighteen patients who underwent the K-technique for laparoscopic apical suspension.
finding: The K-technique was performed on 18 patients with no documented urinary tract injuries or postoperative morbidity during the 6-week postoperative follow-up period, suggesting it is an easy, effective, and safe method for apical vaginal support.
